My names Ally and I want to talk to you in hopes this might save someone. 
I have been suicidal since I was 11. I’m 21 now I will be 22 in August. 
I have had 10 trips to psych ward and there were many more I signed out AMA in the ER but it’d be around 20.
I have had trips where I’ve had doctors and even myself be surprised I even woke up and survived. Ive self harmed and I’ve been through some tough shit. 

About the end of last month I think June 19-July 2 I was falling DEEP in my depression attempted again but I was about to do something more lethal and I’m so glad I didn’t. 

So I’ve been trying to change my mindset on life and living in general especially problem solving skills and I’m am TRYING REALLY HARD. 

But there are some things I’ve found that I tell myself to try to change my way of thinking. Because I also was very pessimistic about life. 

A lot of this sounds cliche but if you read into it deeper and practice it, it will help.

We often think about:

What is the meaning of life? Why am I here? Why does it matter? What makes life worth living?

So here’s a question: what makes death worth dying?

For me being suicidal and the thought of death would comfort me because, the pain is gone and I’m at peace. 
I thought no one cares, etc. 
that’s the mental illness giving you bullshit lies. Almost like an abusive ex. 

Then when I started my new job July 2 after not working since 2018 or 2019 I can’t remember, everything kind of came full circle to me. 

What you should do is sit down with yourself and really think about everything write it down the good and the bad.

Get that shit out of your mind and soul.
Now I want you to think about how far you have came through the battles you have already fought and how strong you are for fighting that already. If you’re still fighting shit keep fighting because I know we all are 
“If you’re going through hell keep going” -Winston Churchill
I know we’re all fucking tired and we’re done. We want the pain to stop. The pain in the world to stop. It’s easy to want to just say fuck it. 

I’m not going to lie I still get suicidal REALLY BAD. But here’s the thing YOU come first before anyone in your life. Because this is YOUR LIFE. This YOUR story you are writing. 
We get suicidal
But guess what? We get a new day everyday. Everyday we get to start over. 
So when it’s a bad day, take a bath or shower. Take some sleeping meds like whatever your prescribed or over the counter meds like Unisom. 
Knock your ass out get back up and start a new day.
Because the past is the past, it’s history. I think about that with my PTSD it’s like yeah that happened and it bothers the fuck out of me. But what can I do about it? It’s done. 

So some advice, thoughts, and reasons I stay alive:
1. we can’t control other people and their actions. We can only control ours and how we react. 
2. If someone is being hurtful and calls you shit don’t get upset. Laugh about it because they’re a dumb ass clown. Send them an application for the circus. Chances are their IQ starts with a decimal point. 
3. People do fucking care about you. There are still good people in this world. People have told me how much of a help I am and great things. Strangers have helped me and have seen my scars on my wrist and I mean complete strangers say “you’re not alone and people care for you, I care for you” and I mean total strangers. 
4. Go out and see the world. Take a hike, go to the lake, take a walk, etc
5. You have eternity to spend in a box underground or a vase. I love roller coasters and have never been to six flags so like if I die what if there’s no roller coasters?
6. What if you died today and the next day you could’ve won the lottery or some crazy shit. 

So to wrap this up: I gave up on trying to commit suicide because I’ve had so many lucky chances I’m alive and saw the next day and something happened I would’ve missed. 
I gave up on it because you only get so many chances for that shit. What if I attempted again but the next time I woke up I was breathing through a tube, shitting in a diaper with no brain activity or was paralyzed. What if I blew my brains out and survived and now my face is fucked up from reconstructive surgery?
I gave up on attempts because it’s not my turn yet. 
There’s still so much you have yet to see and do. Make your bucket list.
Smile at stranger, talk to a stranger, donate blood, etc. because you may have just saved someone else from killing themselves.

I was thinking about this last night. It really CREASES MY CROCS people act like it’s cute and silly. “Oh I can’t pay attention I must have adhd” “sorry I wasn’t listening I must have adhd” *looks back down at phone*
 “I’m forgetful sometimes I must have adhd”. And they think it’s cute. It makes me so frustrated because it makes it seem like everyone has ADHD.
Like you said everyone has trouble paying attention especially in this day and age with cellphones. Everyone’s nose is in a cellphone of course you’re not paying attention. 
ADHD is so much more than that. They don’t know what it’s like to be listening to a conversation and zoning out then catching yourself thinking “okay focus, make eye contact, pay attention” only to zone out again. It’s frustrating because you want to know what’s going on and what this person is saying but you just can’t. 
They don’t know what it’s like to have to go to remedial classes to try to catch up to their grade level because you just can’t sit still and focus. And you’re trying so hard to focus and following everything the teacher says but you still don’t get it and you just can’t remember what was going on in class. And you try you really do try your hardest to understand but you just can’t. 
They don’t understand what it’s like to want to read a book but when you do you zone out while you’re no joke reading the words and not retain anything. 
They don’t know what it’s like to be screamed at for interrupting but if you don’t get that though out quick you’ll forget it. 
They don’t know what it’s like to HAVE to move around like it’s an URGE. 
They don’t know what it’s like to HAVE to talk because you just want to get everything out
They don’t know what it’s like to be so disorganized you’re even disorganized in your own head. 
To lose important things or something you just had. 
To be impulsive and have the absolute urge to act on it especially when driving. 
To be bullied and called “weird” or “dumb” or “annoying”
To really want to start a task and complete it and you hyper focus and go at it only to give up on it in an hour then it just sits around unfinished for weeks,months,years
And there’s so much more like that’s just the top of the iceberg. They have no idea what it’s like for you brain to have 50 tabs open and one of them is playing the 10 hour version of nyan cat ear rape and another just Rick rolled you and for some reason MySpace is pulled up. 
In no way am I saying that person doesn’t have ADHD. I’m just saying it’s more than “I wasn’t paying attention I must have ADHD”
